item.title: Catholic parishes see record growth ahead of Lenten season
item.description: GRANGER, Ind. — Some Roman Catholic parishes are reporting rising membership for the first time in years, and it appears a new generation of worshippers is starting to fill the pews.

item.title: Keon Keeley returns to Notre Dame after two seasons at Alabama
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- Exactly 200 days remain until Notre Dame football kicks off its 2026 season, and one of the most interesting storylines this spring centers on a familiar name.

item.title: Notre Dame adds Purdue transfer kicker Spencer Porath to address 2025 struggles
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- The Irish’s last made field goal of the 2025 season came Oct. 11 against NC State.

item.title: Moon and Mercury snuggle up in Michiana sky
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- Just a few days after Valentine’s Day, we have an entry for cutest couple! The waxing crescent moon snuggled up with Mercury in the western sky this Wednesday evening.

item.title: Plymouth Community School Corporation announces return of paid meals, community speaks out
item.description: PLYMOUTH, Ind. — The Plymouth Community School Corporation sent a letter to parents announcing the return of free, reduced and paid meals for the 2026-2027 school year.

item.title: Fire at Plymouth's Heartland Art Center, no injuries reported
item.description: PLYMOUTH, Ind. -- Wednesday afternoon, the Heartland Art Center experienced a fire within the building.

item.title: Local churches gather for annual Supermarket Sweep donation event
item.description: WARSAW, Ind. -- Some local churches are partnering up with Grace College to collect donations for those in need, and they're doing it with a fun twist based on the popular 90's game show.

item.title: Indiana State Treasurer visits South Bend
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- Indiana State Treasurer, Daniel Elliott, visited South Bend Wednesday to discuss his role in managing the state's investments and helping local governments with financing for major infrastructure projects.

item.title: Saint Joseph County Fire Department dispatched to ice rescue at Chain O' Lakes
item.description: ST. JOSEPH COUNTY, Ind. --- This afternoon, a little after 5 p.m., Saint Joseph County Fire Territory were dispatched to Chain O'Lakes for a report of a subject who had fallen through the ice.

item.title: Residents of St. Joseph County share concerns during Data Center information session
item.description: ST. JOSEPH COUNTY, Ind. -- Wednesday night, Jan Cervelli hosted and moderated an information session at the Harrison Library focused on the Microsoft data center coming to St. Joseph County.
